scientific_question: Is the dense MLP request concentrated in a small, stable set of complete GELU neurons, or is the required functional direction diffuse across most c_fc-row/c_proj-column pairs?

causal_basis.tangent_atlas_finding: A learned full-rank value atlas retained every matrix above 0.999 value cosine but recovered only 0.1166-0.1463 aggregate post-Muon tangent cosine and 0.1424-0.2067 held-out functional-JVP cosine.
causal_basis.factorial_finding: At 5TPP, compact c_fc-only and c_proj-only gaps were +0.0698 and +0.0661 CE, while compacting both was +0.0683 CE; the -0.0676 interaction requires treating each incoming row and outgoing column as one co-adapted neuron.
causal_basis.authorization: The rejected-atlas decision tree authorizes only a zero-update same-replay minimum dense-escape ceiling. No endpoint, fraction sweep, attention composition, or scale-up is authorized by this plan.

theory.complete_atom: For hidden neuron j, deltaY_j = GELU'(s_j)*(X delta_w_fc,j^T)*w_proj,:,j^T + GELU(s_j)*delta_w_proj,:,j^T.
theory.why_paired: GELU is not homogeneous and c_fc/c_proj errors interact strongly, so an incoming row or outgoing column alone is not a gauge-complete functional unit.
theory.fit_score: Within every layer, rank complete neurons by their exact additive inner product <deltaY_j, deltaY_full> on the frozen fit activation bank. This maximizes positive-line contribution at each fixed count without fitting a learned decoder.
theory.heldout_test: Apply the fit-bank order unchanged to a disjoint held-out activation bank and measure exact cumulative functional action, ambient request, and task-gradient line retention.
theory.compact_core_treatment: The Pair-VQ core remains the value carrier. Its measured late requested-update energy is about 0.0118 percent, so the ceiling conservatively attributes tangent recovery only to the selected dense pairs.
theory.interpretation: This is a sparsity/localization ceiling. It can authorize one honest hybrid endpoint, never a full-replacement claim.

frozen_protocol.training_parent: exact 124M QK-only dense-MLP synchronized replay, seed 1337, 238 updates, LR 0.0024, fixed data and schedule
frozen_protocol.dense_gradient_variant: fit-window exact dense path; held-out gradients are used only for task-line scoring
frozen_protocol.muon_history: identical live dense momentum buffer and native five-step Newton-Schulz polar map

dense_escape.unit: complete hidden neuron: one c_fc row plus the matched c_proj column

decision_rule.selection: Choose the smallest fraction passing every functional gate at both late probes.
decision_rule.actionable_pass: If the selected fraction is at most 0.25, seal the hybrid ceiling and authorize exactly one matched 124M/5TPP endpoint at that fraction after implementation, state/resume, and MFU gates.
decision_rule.diffuse_rejection: If only fractions above 0.25 pass, classify the direction as diffuse and reject this dense-escape hybrid as economically unhelpful.
decision_rule.invalid_oracle: If the full fraction fails the sanity gate, classify the oracle invalid and repair measurement code without drawing a scientific conclusion.
decision_rule.future_endpoint_ce_gate: A future endpoint must be at most 0.01 CE above its exact QK-only dense-MLP parent or the hybrid is rejected.

state_and_compute_contract.candidate_checkpoint_if_later_authorized: Pair-VQ core plus selected paired dense weights and their exact optimizer state
required_report: total persistent state including Pair-VQ core
held-out functional and task-line recovery at every fraction
fixed-checkpoint CE and compute-equivalent penalty for any later endpoint

operations.expected_duration: more than five minutes because the exact synchronized replay reaches two late probes
operations.watchdog: one idempotent terminal/error-only watchdog; no progress milestones or heartbeat for an expected one-to-two-hour oracle
operations.callback: Terminal success asks @Codex to verify hashes and gates, seal notes, and continue only with the selected causal branch. Failure asks @Codex to diagnose and repair only if the frozen oracle remains valid.
